# Ruby Pinch (Berry Pinch)

[![Ruby Pinch holding a jump rope — Hasbro Studios/DHX Media, Lesson Zero (S2E3)](https://cdn.twibooru.org/img/view/2025/7/17/3559158__safe_derpibooru%2Bimport_screencap_ruby%2Bpinch_earth%2Bpony_pony_g4_lesson%2Bzero_cropped_cute_female_filly_foal_image_jump%2Brope_mouth%2Bhold_my%2Blittle.png)](https://www.twibooru.org/3559158)

Ruby Pinch is the little pink Ponyville school reporter who stands up for the previous editor of the Foal Free Press. Recognize her by her rose-pink coat, two-tone magenta mane and tail, lime-green eyes and usually a unicorn horn. Her model sometimes appears as a pegasus or earth pony; her cutie mark varies between gems, a clover, a horseshoe, a cupcake and no mark. [Character and appearance guide](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Ruby_Pinch).

- **Names:** Ruby Pinch and Berry Pinch are fandom names, documented in [early fan transcription discussion from April 2012](https://www.equestriadaily.com/2011/12/scripts-scripts-pony-scripts.html?variant=3ass%3D). The latter reflects her association with Berry Punch (Berryshine); fans often portray her as Berry's daughter, but the television series does not establish that relationship. [Fandom naming and background](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/my-little-pony-character-fandom). Gameloft's licensed mobile game calls her [Winsome Schoolpony](https://mlp-gameloft.fandom.com/wiki/Winsome_Schoolpony), not her confirmed television name.
- **Voice:** A speaking background character; the character guide attributes her English voice to Cathy Weseluck, citing a 2012 tweet that I could not independently retrieve.
- **Appearances:** Debuts in Friendship Is Magic, Part 2 (S1E2) as a pegasus; appears throughout the series, including Twilight Time, Slice of Life, Amending Fences, School Daze and The Last Crusade. Her design also appears in IDW's My Little Pony/Transformers #2, page 11, according to the character guide.

## Important moments

- **Pulled to safety — Bridle Gossip (S1E9):** Berry Punch pulls her indoors as Zecora approaches, inspiring the fandom's family interpretation. [Full episode on Tubi](https://tubitv.com/tv-shows/200198838/s01-e09-bridle-gossip) (timestamp unavailable).
- **Defends the old editor — Ponyville Confidential (S2E23):** She objects when Diamond Tiara disparages Namby-Pamby, showing her willingness to speak up for the previous editor before the school paper turns to gossip. [Episode source](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ponyville_Confidential) (timestamp unavailable).
- **An unsettling welcome — The Cutie Map, Part 1 (S5E1):** Her character model is among the villagers greeting the Mane Six in unison, reinforcing the unsettling conformity of Starlight Glimmer's settlement. [Full episode on ABC iview](https://iview.abc.net.au/show/my-little-pony-friendship-is-magic/series/5/video/ZW4153A001S00) (timestamp unavailable).

Research limits: Some wiki pages were available through indexed text but blocked direct retrieval. Scene timestamps and the original voice-credit tweet could not be verified; no individual animator is attributed to the production still.
